Parallel ATA.fact: The introduction of ATAPI (ATA Packet Interface) by the Small Form Factor Committee (SFF) allowed ATA to be used for a variety of other devices that require functions beyond those necessary for hard disk drives.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: ATAPI is a protocol allowing the ATA interface to carry _____ commands and responses; therefore, all ATAPI devices are actually "speaking SCSI" other than at the electrical interface
Parallel ATA.fact: ATAPI is a protocol allowing the ATA interface to carry SCSI commands and responses; therefore, all ATAPI devices are actually "speaking SCSI" other than at the electrical interface. The SCSI commands and responses are embedded in "packets" (hence "ATA Packet Interface") for transmission on the ATA cable.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: This allows any device class for which a _____ command set has been defined to be interfaced via ATA/ATAPI
Parallel ATA.fact: ATAPI is a protocol allowing the ATA interface to carry SCSI commands and responses; therefore, all ATAPI devices are actually "speaking SCSI" other than at the electrical interface. Parallel ATA.fact: In principle any device controlled by a SCSI command set could be supported over ATAPI given appropriate adapter and driver support, though in practice adoption was primarily by CD storage drives, DVD storage drives, and high-capacity floppy drives, such as the Zip drive and SuperDisk drive. Parallel ATA.fact: ATAPI was adopted as part of ATA in INCITS 317-1998, AT Attachment with Packet Interface Extension (ATA/ATAPI-4).

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: ATAPI was adopted as part of ATA in INCITS 317-1998, AT Attachment with _____ (ATA/ATAPI-4)
Parallel ATA.fact: ATAPI was adopted as part of ATA in INCITS 317-1998, AT Attachment with Packet Interface Extension (ATA/ATAPI-4).

Parallel ATA.question: In later versions, faster _____ DMA modes were added, requiring new 80-wire cables to reduce crosstalk
Parallel ATA.fact: In later versions, faster Ultra DMA modes were added, requiring new 80-wire cables to reduce crosstalk. Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: Most of Western Digital's changes, along with others, were included in the ATA/ATAPI-6 standard (_____)
Parallel ATA.fact: Most of Western Digital's changes, along with others, were included in the ATA/ATAPI-6 standard (2002).

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The first of these BIOS limits occurred when ATA drives reached sizes in excess of 504 MiB, because some motherboard BIOSes would not allow C/H/S values above _____ cylinders, 16 heads, and 63 sectors
Parallel ATA.fact: The first of these BIOS limits occurred when ATA drives reached sizes in excess of 504 MiB, because some motherboard BIOSes would not allow C/H/S values above 1024 cylinders, 16 heads, and 63 sectors. Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The second of these BIOS limitations occurred at _____ cylinders, 256 heads, and 63 sectors, and a problem in MS-DOS limited the number of heads to 255
Parallel ATA.fact: The first of these BIOS limits occurred when ATA drives reached sizes in excess of 504 MiB, because some motherboard BIOSes would not allow C/H/S values above 1024 cylinders, 16 heads, and 63 sectors. The second of these BIOS limitations occurred at 1024 cylinders, 256 heads, and 63 sectors, and a problem in MS-DOS limited the number of heads to 255.

Parallel ATA.fact: Later, an extension to the x86 BIOS disk services called the "Enhanced Disk Drive" (EDD) was made available, which makes it possible to address drives as large as 264 sectors.

Parallel ATA.fact: Some operating systems, including Windows XP pre-SP1, and Windows 2000 pre-SP3, disable LBA48 by default, requiring the user to take extra steps to use the entire capacity of an ATA drive larger than about 137 gigabytes. Parallel ATA.fact: Often, these additional connectors were implemented by inexpensive RAID controllers.

Parallel ATA.fact: Soon after the introduction of Serial ATA (SATA) in 2003, use of Parallel ATA declined.

Parallel ATA.fact: Soon after the introduction of Serial ATA (SATA) in 2003, use of Parallel ATA declined. Some PCs and laptops of the era have a SATA hard disk and an optical drive connected to PATA.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: As of _____, some PC chipsets, for example the Intel ICH10, had removed support for PATA

Parallel ATA.fact: With Western Digital's withdrawal from the PATA market, hard disk drives with the PATA interface were no longer in production after December 2013 for other than specialty applications.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine

Parallel ATA.fact: Capacitive coupling is more of a problem at higher transfer rates, and this change was necessary to enable the 66 megabytes per second (MB/s) transfer rate of UDMA4 to work reliably. The faster UDMA5 and UDMA6 modes also require 80-conductor cables.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The gray connector on 80-conductor cables has pin 28 _____ not connected, making it the slave position for drives configured cable select

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The Device 0 drive is the drive that usually appears "first" to the computer's _____ and/or operating system
Parallel ATA.fact: The Device 0 drive is the drive that usually appears "first" to the computer's BIOS and/or operating system.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: In most personal computers the drives are often designated as "C:" for the _____ 0 and "D:" for the Device 1 referring to one active primary partitions on each
Parallel ATA.fact: The Device 0 drive is the drive that usually appears "first" to the computer's BIOS and/or operating system. In most personal computers the drives are often designated as "C:" for the Device 0 and "D:" for the Device 1 referring to one active primary partitions on each.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The mode that a device must use is often set by a jumper setting on the device itself, which must be manually set to _____ 0 (Master) or Device 1 (Slave)
Parallel ATA.fact: The Device 0 drive is the drive that usually appears "first" to the computer's BIOS and/or operating system. In most personal computers the drives are often designated as "C:" for the Device 0 and "D:" for the Device 1 referring to one active primary partitions on each.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: If there is a single device on a cable, it should be configured as _____ 0
Parallel ATA.fact: The Device 0 drive is the drive that usually appears "first" to the computer's BIOS and/or operating system. In most personal computers the drives are often designated as "C:" for the Device 0 and "D:" for the Device 1 referring to one active primary partitions on each.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: However, some certain era drives have a special setting called Single for this configuration (_____, in particular)
Parallel ATA.fact: However, some certain era drives have a special setting called Single for this configuration (Western Digital, in particular).

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: A drive set to "cable select" automatically configures itself as _____ 0 or Device 1, according to its position on the cable
Parallel ATA.fact: A drive set to "cable select" automatically configures itself as Device 0 or Device 1, according to its position on the cable. The host adapter grounds this pin; if a device sees that the pin is grounded, it becomes the Device 0 (master) device; if it sees that pin 28 is open, the device becomes the Device 1 (slave) device.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: The host adapter grounds this pin; if a device sees that the pin is grounded, it becomes the _____ 0 (master) device; if it sees that pin 28 is open, the device becomes the Device 1 (slave) device
Parallel ATA.fact: A drive set to "cable select" automatically configures itself as Device 0 or Device 1, according to its position on the cable. The host adapter grounds this pin; if a device sees that the pin is grounded, it becomes the Device 0 (master) device; if it sees that pin 28 is open, the device becomes the Device 1 (slave) device.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: This setting is usually chosen by a jumper setting on the drive called "cable select", usually marked CS, which is separate from the _____ 0/1 setting
Parallel ATA.fact: A drive set to "cable select" automatically configures itself as Device 0 or Device 1, according to its position on the cable. The host adapter grounds this pin; if a device sees that the pin is grounded, it becomes the Device 0 (master) device; if it sees that pin 28 is open, the device becomes the Device 1 (slave) device.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: If two drives are configured as _____ 0 and Device 1 manually, this configuration does not need to correspond to their position on the cable

This setting is usually chosen by a jumper setting on the drive called "cable select", usually marked CS, which is separate from the Device 0/1 setting.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: So, if there is only one (_____ 0) device on a two-drive cable, using the black connector, there is no cable stub to cause reflections (the unused connector is now in the middle of the ribbon)
Parallel ATA.fact: Starting with the 80-conductor cable defined for use in ATAPI5/UDMA4, the master Device 0 device goes at the far-from-the-host end of the 18-inch (460 mm) cable on the black connector, the slave Device 1 goes on the grey middle connector, and the blue connector goes to the host (e.g. So, if there is only one (Device 0) device on a two-drive cable, using the black connector, there is no cable stub to cause reflections (the unused connector is now in the middle of the ribbon).

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: This has long been seen as a major advantage of _____
Parallel ATA.fact: By contrast, overlapped and queued operations have been common in other storage buses; in particular, SCSI's version of tagged command queuing had no need to be compatible with APIs designed for ISA, allowing it to attain high performance with low overhead on buses which supported first party DMA like PCI. This has long been seen as a major advantage of SCSI.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: A device can have two passwords: A _____ and a Master Password; either or both may be set
Parallel ATA.fact: A device can have two passwords: A User Password and a Master Password; either or both may be set. The master password, if set, can used by the administrator to reset user password, if the end user forgot the user password.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: There is a _____ identifier feature which, if supported and used, can identify the current Master Password (without disclosing it)
Parallel ATA.fact: A device can have two passwords: A User Password and a Master Password; either or both may be set. There is a Master Password identifier feature which, if supported and used, can identify the current Master Password (without disclosing it).

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: On some laptops and some business computers, their _____ can control the ATA passwords
Parallel ATA.fact: On some laptops and some business computers, their BIOS can control the ATA passwords.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: A device can be locked in two modes: High security mode or _____ security mode
Parallel ATA.fact: A device can be locked in two modes: High security mode or Maximum security mode. Bit 8 in word 128 of the IDENTIFY response shows which mode the disk is in: 0 = High, 1 = Maximum.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: Bit 8 in word 128 of the IDENTIFY response shows which mode the disk is in: 0 = High, 1 = _____
Parallel ATA.fact: A device can be locked in two modes: High security mode or Maximum security mode. Bit 8 in word 128 of the IDENTIFY response shows which mode the disk is in: 0 = High, 1 = Maximum.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: In High security mode, the device can be unlocked with either the User or _____ password, using the "SECURITY UNLOCK DEVICE" ATA command
Parallel ATA.fact: In High security mode, the device can be unlocked with either the User or Master password, using the "SECURITY UNLOCK DEVICE" ATA command. Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or Master password.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or _____ password
Parallel ATA.fact: In High security mode, the device can be unlocked with either the User or Master password, using the "SECURITY UNLOCK DEVICE" ATA command. Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or Master password.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: In Maximum security mode, the device can be unlocked only with the _____ password
Parallel ATA.fact: In High security mode, the device can be unlocked with either the User or Master password, using the "SECURITY UNLOCK DEVICE" ATA command. Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or Master password.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: In Maximum security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command requires the _____ password and will completely erase all data on the disk
Parallel ATA.fact: In High security mode, the device can be unlocked with either the User or Master password, using the "SECURITY UNLOCK DEVICE" ATA command. Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or Master password.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: If the User password is not available, the only remaining way to get at least the bare hardware back to a usable state is to issue the SECURITY ERASE PREPARE command, immediately followed by _____
Parallel ATA.fact: Also in High security mode, the SECURITY ERASE UNIT command can be used with either the User or Master password. If the User password is not available, the only remaining way to get at least the bare hardware back to a usable state is to issue the SECURITY ERASE PREPARE command, immediately followed by SECURITY ERASE UNIT.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: For NVMe drives, the security features, including lock passwords, were defined in the _____ standard
Parallel ATA.fact: For NVMe drives, the security features, including lock passwords, were defined in the OPAL standard.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: For sanitizing entire disks, the built-in _____ command is effective when implemented correctly
Parallel ATA.fact: For sanitizing entire disks, the built-in Secure Erase command is effective when implemented correctly. Some laptops and business computers have a BIOS that can utilize Secure Erase to erase all data on the disk.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: Some laptops and business computers have a BIOS that can utilize _____ to erase all data on the disk
Parallel ATA.fact: For sanitizing entire disks, the built-in Secure Erase command is effective when implemented correctly. Some laptops and business computers have a BIOS that can utilize Secure Erase to erase all data on the disk.

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: External hard disk drives or optical disk drives that have an internal _____ interface, use some other interface technology to bridge the distance between the external device and the computer

Parallel ATA.subject: Health & Medicine
Parallel ATA.question: A bridge chip inside the external devices converts from the USB interface to _____, and typically only supports a single external device without cable select or master/slave
